title: Show the retimed pair keeps rank mass 5135 while lowering the moment
body:
## Summary
- Replacing `H1 + H2` by `H3` on two pairs changes the local histogram from `{1:2439, 2:726, 3:224, 4:102, 5:20, 8:8}` to `{1:2437, 2:724, 3:226, 4:102, 5:20, 8:8}`.
- The rank change is `-2·1 − 2·2 + 2·3 = 0`, so both histograms have rank mass 5,135. The width inventory still sums to 408 helpers.
- For every rational `p` strictly between 0 and 1, `3^p < 1 + 2^p`, so the moment strictly decreases. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
